data_fields.name: stack_free_space_rule
data_fields.donor_constant: max - count, 0 at or over max

data_fields.name: infinite_side_marker
data_fields.donor_constant: -1 (no count limit, stack restored after move)

best_idea: A move is decided before it happens: each side states how many units it accepts, the move takes the smallest, a swap happens only when the destination takes nothing and both directions accept whole stacks, and whatever does not fit goes back to the source.
decision_why: Keeps the two-sided permit with the minimum count, the swap rule and the leftover-to-source step, which give one move function and server-read counts; replaces Lua callbacks with typed server rules and enforces the stack max explicitly, since the donor lets an empty slot take any count.
acceptance: A server test: moving 10 units from a 20-stack into a slot of the same item with 5 units of room moves exactly 5, leaves 15 in the source and changes nothing else; a move onto a different item is refused, with both slots unchanged, when the reverse side refuses the whole destination stack.
